test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

The sound of owls
solution:
The correct answer is **Hoot**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"hoot"** refers to the sound made by owls. (उल्लू द्वारा निकाली गई ध्वनि)
 
• It is a verb that means to make a low, wavering, or slightly harsh sound.
 
 
• Example: *The owl **hooted**__ loudly in the night.*
